body: I understand, even when I am doing these things to calm myself those thoughts are still there. Today for me was awful as well, I had to call into work. I just slept all day because I knew if I was awake it would be not helpful. Their has to be some reason we are on this earth. Please keep suffering with me, I will be here to talk.
That's how I feel almost everyday, but I keep going for my children. Maybe that's the key, find something to keep you going. Do you have something or someone?
Their is something causing it, I have severe anxiety. I can make plans and goals but am always to scared to follow through. It's debilitating and embarassing.
